desc: Ideation: model operation as mirror on ordered rooted forest, identify unordered forest invariant and counting DP.
Formalize proof: valid contiguous substrings ↔ consecutive sibling forests; mirror action; invariant; adjacent-swap lemma (AB → m(A)B → m(A)m(B) → BA using m∘m=id); independence across nodes.

Implement parser and canonicalization: scan S, build child-id lists, assign class ids via sorted child tuples, compute ways bottom-up with memoization, including factorial/invfact precomputation and top-level forest answer.
Handle robustness: raised recursion limit (1e6) suffices for depth ≤ N/2 = 2500, O(sum k log k) sorting, O(N) memory.
Verify logic: traced Sample 1 → 2 and Sample 2 → 1; checked identical-subtree cases (()()()() → 1, (()()) → 1) and the m∘m = identity restoration in the 3-mirror adjacent swap.
